context: A 3×3 gallery of 9 D3 cells, each demonstrating a different shape-morphing animation pair (Circle↔Rectangle, Bar↔Pie, Star↔Circle, Line↔Area, Scatter↔Bar, Horizontal↔Vertical, Grouped↔Stacked, Treemap↔CirclePack, Donut↔Sunburst), all looping independently with 400ms staggered starts.
first_impression: Clean card-based gallery with clear labels, but 9 simultaneously looping animations compete for attention and the screenshot captures several cells mid-blank due to staggered initialization.
what_works: Card layout with labeled cells cleanly isolates each demo as a self-contained unit, making the 9-cell count manageable as a lookup gallery rather than a simultaneous comparison; colorblind-safe Tol palettes are used throughout with restrained per-cell color counts (3–7 hues max).
what_doesnt: Nine independent looping animations running concurrently pull the viewer's eye in all directions at once, undermining focus on any single morphing technique; the staggered 400ms initialization means the bottom two rows render blank for up to 3+ seconds, which the screenshot captures as empty cells that look like failures.
